sources.discovery_semantics: A model detail page whose snapshot section contains an exact API identifier matching the allowlisted pattern.
sources.limitations: Documentation establishes identity and only explicitly supported structured endpoint/capability cards; account access still requires the authenticated model list.
sources.expected_instability: Navigation and title markup may change; unexpected detail pages fail individually.
sources.availability_semantics: Documentation confirms identity, not account access.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact Claude API ID in the official model overview comparison table.
sources.limitations: The table does not prove account access or consumer-product adoption.
sources.expected_instability: Table headings or column order may change; absence of the API-ID row fails the adapter.
sources.availability_semantics: Claude API ID row, not Bedrock or consumer identity.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact Gemini API identifier in the official models table.
sources.limitations: Documentation identity does not prove project access or availability in Gemini consumer products.
sources.expected_instability: Table markup and localized labels may change; missing endpoint rows fail the adapter.
sources.availability_semantics: Endpoint column confirms ID, not account access.

sources.discovery_semantics: A model detail page containing its exact Grok API identifier.
sources.limitations: Documentation establishes identity only; image/video pages outside the language-model contract fail conservatively.
sources.expected_instability: Page titles and navigation routes may change; unexpected detail formats fail individually.
sources.availability_semantics: Model documentation is not an access test.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact model ID returned by the official account-scoped models endpoint.
sources.limitations: Listing proves account visibility, not endpoint compatibility or successful inference.
sources.expected_instability: Account entitlements vary; missing credentials are reported without changing canonical state.
sources.availability_semantics: Listing confirms account-visible ID, not endpoint compatibility or successful generation.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact Claude model ID returned by the official models endpoint.
sources.limitations: Listing and declared capabilities do not prove a successful paid inference or consumer availability.
sources.expected_instability: Account entitlements and pagination may change; failures do not remove models.
sources.availability_semantics: Listing and explicit capabilities; no paid generation.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact models/ identifier returned by the Gemini API model-list endpoint.
sources.limitations: Generation methods describe endpoints but do not prove a successful probe or consumer availability.
sources.expected_instability: Account/project visibility and pagination tokens may change; failures do not remove models.
sources.availability_semantics: supportedGenerationMethods describes endpoints, not successful probes.

sources.discovery_semantics: An exact Grok model ID returned by the official language-model list endpoint.
